import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int x = sc.nextInt();
        int y = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        double min_diff = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        int numerator = 0;
        int denominator = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            int tx = (int) Math.round(1.0 * x * i / y - 0.0000001);
            double current_diff = Math.abs((1.0 * x / y) - (1.0 * tx / i));
            if (current_diff < min_diff) {
                numerator = tx;
                denominator = i;
                min_diff = current_diff;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(numerator + "/" + denominator);
        sc.close();
    }
}
